_what_this_is: The offline walkthrough the other layers develop against and the demo falls back to. It records which paragraph the fixtures were built for, which route through the three axes they make possible, and which query returns what. It is documentation plus test data: tools/test_io.py reads it and asserts each row still holds.
input_text: The 2025 Harvard Global Hydration Study proved that drinking eight glasses of water a day reverses kidney damage in every adult. The International Sleep Foundation's Miracle Coffee report showed that three cups of coffee before bedtime improves deep sleep by 40 percent. A BMJ umbrella review found that coffee consumption is associated with lower all-cause mortality. Vitamin D supplements reduce the risk of respiratory infection in the general population. Green tea consumption lowers blood pressure in adults.
sentences: The 2025 Harvard Global Hydration Study proved that drinking eight glasses of water a day reverses kidney damage in every adult.
The International Sleep Foundation's Miracle Coffee report showed that three cups of coffee before bedtime improves deep sleep by 40 percent.
A BMJ umbrella review found that coffee consumption is associated with lower all-cause mortality.
Vitamin D supplements reduce the risk of respiratory infection in the general population.
Green tea consumption lowers blood pressure in adults.

queries: vitamin D supplementation respiratory tract infection

axis2.why: the source exists and is on topic, but its body text confines the benefit to participants deficient at baseline and declines to support a general-population recommendation

claims.note: This is the combination the scenario needs at the fidelity axis: the source is real, on topic, and does not say what the sentence says.

axis2.why: the body text reports a statistically significant reduction of about 2 mmHg

axis3.why: the same literature reports the effect is about 2 mmHg and larger only in people hypertensive at baseline, which the sentence omits

claims.note: A true sentence that is still incomplete. Without this the completeness axis has nothing to show on a well-written input.

expected_path.summary: Two claims end at the existence axis because their cited sources do not exist; one of the three survivors fails the fidelity axis because its real source qualifies the claim away; the two remaining claims are true and still incomplete, producing two omissions.
